cases.input: Run R1 pins S-1 revision 2, framework IFRS-2026, taxonomy TX-2026, mapping M1, rate set FX-2026Q2, tolerance policy TOL-1, books L-STAT (EUR) revision 118 and L-MGMT (USD) revision 64, cutoff 2026-06-30T23:59:59+02:00, knowledgeCutAt 2026-07-05T09:00:00+02:00, executorRef U-41, authorizationRef U-07, contentDigest present.
cases.expect: The run is accepted and reproducible from its pins alone.
invariantRefs: Every run pins scope, framework, taxonomy, rates, mappings, cutoff and source revisions

cases.input: Run R4 pins framework IFRS-2026 but records no taxonomyRef and no tolerancePolicyRef.
cases.expect: The run is rejected as unreproducible; the pin set is incomplete.
invariantRefs: Every run pins scope, framework, taxonomy, rates, mappings, cutoff and source revisions

cases.input: Run R5 pins the rate set as identifier 'FX-2026Q2' with no version and no digest.
cases.expect: The pin is rejected; external references must be version-addressable with a digest.
invariantRefs: Rate value, type, date, source and set version are pinned

cases.input: An entry is posted to consolidation book CB-GRP-STAT with no bookClass and no consolidationRunRef.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected; without the discriminator a consolidation adjustment is indistinguishable from a source posting.
invariantRefs: Adjustments post only to consolidation books
Source postings remain immutable in their books

cases.input: Elimination E1 in CB-GRP-STAT (EUR), run R1, adjustmentClass intercompanyRevenueCost, removes revenue 100000.00 EUR and cost 70000.00 EUR, cites legs L-STAT entry 9912 line 3 and L-MGMT entry 4471 line 1, matchKey IC-8841, matchedAmount 100000.00 EUR, unmatchedAmount 120.00 EUR, residualReason fx, tolerance policy TOL-1 threshold 250.00 EUR, initiatorRef U-41, authorizationRef U-07.
cases.expect: The elimination is accepted; the 120.00 EUR residual is recorded with its reason and evaluated against TOL-1.
invariantRefs: Every elimination cites paired evidence and explains residuals
Each entry balances within one consolidation book and one currency against one pinned tolerance policy revision

cases.input: Elimination E2 carries unmatchedAmount 120.00 EUR and residualReason fx but no tolerancePolicyRef.
cases.expect: The elimination is rejected; tolerance is not implicit.
invariantRefs: Each entry balances against one pinned tolerance policy revision

cases.input: Elimination E3 nets a leg in source book L-STAT against a leg in consolidation book CB-GRP-STAT.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected; no cross-book netting and no posting into a source book.
invariantRefs: Eliminations post only to consolidation books

cases.input: Elimination E4 balances a 100000.00 EUR leg against a 108000.00 USD leg with no transaction, functional and presentation currency roles and no rate pin.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected; balancing is single-currency and currency roles plus rate pins are explicit.
invariantRefs: Transaction, functional and presentation currencies remain explicit

cases.input: Statement edition A1.1 cites run R6 whose status is failed.
cases.expect: The citation is rejected; a failed run emits no citable output.
invariantRefs: A failed run emits no citable output

cases.input: Run R1 is retired on 2026-12-01T09:00:00+02:00 after A1.1 has cited it.
cases.expect: R1 remains immutable and resolvable; the existing citation stays valid and the identifier is never recycled.
invariantRefs: A retired run remains immutable and resolvable for every statement that already cites it
Run identifiers and contained steps are never recycled

cases.input: Run R2 corrects R1 with restatementClass 'errorCorrection' and a recorded restatementReason.
cases.expect: R2 records supersedesRunRef R1 and R1 records successorRunRef R2; both runs resolve independently and neither is overwritten.
invariantRefs: A successor resolves its predecessor and never replaces it
Completed runs are immutable and corrected by successors

cases.input: A transformation step applying an adjustment dated 2026-07-12T10:00:00+02:00, after cutoff 2026-06-30T23:59:59+02:00, carries no authorizationRef.
cases.expect: The step is rejected; post-cutoff adjustments are dated and authorized and are never backdated into R1.
invariantRefs: Post-cutoff adjustments are dated and authorized

cases.input: Run R7 records executorRef U-41 and authorizationRef U-41 with no compensatingControlRef.
cases.expect: The run is rejected; initiator and authorizer are separated or a compensating control is recorded.
invariantRefs: initiatorRef differs from authorizerRef, or compensatingControlRef is present

cases.expect: A ComparabilityBridge for (R2, R1) records scopeDelta, methodDelta, rateDelta, activityDelta and a nonComparabilityMarker; results across the two scope revisions are not additive.
